additional_info.subject: ID0471169-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Power converter Issue CRM:03288000086
additional_info.body:
Dear Giuseppe,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the information provided, a deeper system check, and a soft reboot of your charging station, we can confirm that the issue is resolved. We have identified that the fault was caused by a bug in the previous software version, which you updated this morning.
We will continue to monitor the charger for the next few days. Should the error recur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed to close the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0471169-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Power converter Issue CRM:03277000043
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0471169
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
CHR-18
Charger ID / Serial No.:
UcHLBv
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
The client has reported the issue “
Missing Converters in DC1
”, which has been confirmed after our checks:
Please attend site and carry out the following steps:
First, check the cables connected to the converter and ensure they are properly attached.
If the cables are fine, swap the faulty converter with the adjacent one to determine if the issue lies with the cables or the converter itself.
If the converter is confirmed faulty, replace it.
I will provide the reference number of the convertor:
8EM5903-0AA04-7AA5 -TB1, -TB2, … -TB10 - Power converter AC-DC 40 kW Type Huawei R100040G2
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Ivan Perotto
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
